args: Fix the flakiness in app/frontend/tests/e2e/gui-toolbar-fold.spec.ts — the gui header fold real-widths suite fails intermittently on main and in CI (sole cause of PR #1105's red CI; rerun passed). Local repro: just test-e2e gui-toolbar-fold --repeat-each 3 --retries 0 fails ~3-4 of 12 runs on both main and the ogop branch. Failure modes: (1) spring did not converge to 300 from resizeToSpring's iterate-to-2px loop, (2) Toggle stats not visible at full+cap+40 target, (3) resolution label not degraded at mid-band target. The ResizeObserver re-fit is not atomic with the resize and the header's shrinkable meta chip makes viewport-to-spring overhead non-constant, so pixel-boundary targets and 2px convergence are fragile. Make the suite deterministic without weakening what the tests prove. Acceptance: repeat-each 5 --retries 0 passes 20/20 locally; CI E2E shards pass.
